api.description: Same-origin JSON client with the standard error envelope and an injected auth-expiry hook; useOnline and isOfflineError.

pwa.description: Service-worker registration and update lifecycle (onUpdate); the service worker itself is installed by template (copy it on upgrade; app code goes in sw-app.js).

pwa-shell.description: iOS-standalone-safe mobile shell: large-viewport height, keyboard handling, nav as the last flex child, published nav height, a nav badge slot (count or dot at the icon, 99+, no layout shift).

profile.description: The signed-in person bottom left (photo from directory) opening a menu: de/en, light/dark, the app's own settings and the person's other apps; backend: Go package profile at /api/me; public/profile-theme.js sets the stored theme before the first paint and keeps the theme-color meta in step.

pull-refresh.description: usePullToRefresh on the shell's scroller: standalone touch only, from the top, sideways swipes ignored, damping, threshold, minimum spin, off while a dialog is open; indicator app-owned.

sheet.description: Bottom-sheet behaviour on a native <dialog>: top layer, scroll lock on the shell's scroller, safe area, Escape for the topmost, focus back to the opener, drag down to close; look app-owned.

toast.description: Headless toast store (queue, durations, undo, pause, status/alert) and an unstyled ToastRegion in the top layer above the nav; look app-owned.

template.description: Minimal React/Vite application with app-owned content, theme, query policy, top bar and nav on the shared shell.

push.description: Web Push: sw-push.js for the app's sw-app.js (checked payload, tag per subject, app badge, same-origin click that focuses before it navigates) and usePush/setAppBadge on the page.

palette.description: Command palette logic without a look: rank (umlaut and accent folding, aliases, fuzzy), recent picks, isTypingTarget and a keyboard shortcut handler with typing, dialog, AltGr and IME guards.

scroll-edges.description: useScrollEdges marks a sideways scroller with data-more-start/end; .edge-fade fades those edges with a mask only (no colour).

touch.description: Touch ergonomics in @layer foundation: 16px fields and 44px controls on coarse pointers, no tap highlight or double-tap delay, text-size-adjust, .hit-target, opt-in .no-pan-x frame.

motion.description: Reduced-motion policy (no tokens) plus prefersReducedMotion, useReducedMotion, useEntrance (first insert only), viewTransition with fallback, useSlidingIndicator.

phone-audit.description: Playwright phone audit at 375x667 and 390x844 (touch): sideways pan, text and number overflow, 44px targets, 16px fields, 14px text, axe, autofocus, refetch layout shift, reduced motion, platform rules.
